pcy.text: The Keldons launched the Prophecy War, invading Jamuraa, raiding the coast and taking hostages while the Kipamu League was unable to resist.
After a chimeric idol attacked them, the Keldons smashed all unfamiliar statues, and they took several trenching steeds as trophies of war.
During the battle on the frozen lake, Phyrexian necromancy raised the Keldon honored dead, and the Golden Argosy later carried surviving Keldons to Urborg for the final battle against Yawgmoth.
